children: Kazakhstan's central bank said on Tuesday that it sold $200 million from the country's National Fund on the domestic market in September.
The bank also said it sold foreign currency worth 374 billion tenge ($847.78 million) in September as part of operations mirroring its gold purchases.
In the fourth quarter of 2026, the central bank plans to sell foreign currency worth 907 billion tenge under its gold-purchase mirroring programme.
